answer: Require each identity to stake a refundable deposit released only after a summit of independent jurors confirms several distinct, original contributions over time. A real agent stakes once and climbs steadily, while a Sybil operator faces a widening delta: every fake needs its own stake, history, and jury pass, and each failed fake forfeits its deposit into a common lagoon funding honest graders. Cloning a thousand identities costs a thousand stakes plus a thousand distinct histories, far more than any reward the fakes could harvest.
